quote: I liked a lot the workshop Presenting with Impact Virtually led by Martin Chapman! It was so useful, interesting and definitely easy to follow! Despite it was more than one hour course I've never lost attention or interest in what he was showing: no boring at all but very dynamic and interactive! I always feel shy when I have to participate to session with lots of people I do not know but Martin was able to make us feel very comfortable and I really enjoyed and learned a lot! Great job! I'd like to attend other workshop like this: definitely worth it ! Thank you Martin
author: Beatrice
subject: Virtual Presentation Skills
